stocks.rule: Monitor continuously while the authoritative exchange session is open; never force a buy when the session or data gates fail.

crypto.rule: Monitor continuously; broker availability, liquidity, freshness and risk gates still control entries.

brokerMcp.note: Repository cannot prove live Robinhood MCP connectivity; Claude must verify on every execution run.

runner.note: GitHub job status is authoritative for runner availability; scheduled sessions retry every five minutes and active sessions cycle about every 45 seconds.

replay.rule: Replay uses historical 1m paths for Robinhood-confirmed resolved trades; it never rewrites broker fills or PnL.

riskOfRuin.note: Do not publish a precise ruin probability until enough independent real trades and stable sizing assumptions exist.
